server_name.description: The name of the JACK server instance. Defaults to 'default' if not set.

realtime.description: Enable realtime scheduling for reliable low-latency performance.

rt_priority.description: The realtime scheduler priority level. Valid range depends on system configuration, typically 1-99.

no_mlock.description: Do not attempt to lock memory into RAM, even if realtime is enabled.

verbose.description: Give verbose output, helpful for troubleshooting.

midi_bufsize.description: Size of the buffer used for MIDI ports in MIDI events per process cycle.

nozombies.description: Prevent JACK from kicking out clients because they were too slow.

timeout_thresh.description: Number of consecutive process cycles that must fail before JACK gives up processing.

additional_devices.description: List of additional ALSA hardware devices to attach using the -A option format (e.g., 'SB', 'hw:1%c'). Items are strings.

internal_clients.description: List of internal client specifications to load using the -I option. Items are strings in format 'client-name:client-path' or 'client-path'.

slave_driver.description: Name of the slave driver to load, e.g., 'alsa_midi' for ALSA MIDI bridging.

driver.description: The audio backend driver to use. Supported values include 'alsa', 'dummy', 'portaudio', 'net', 'oss', 'sun', 'sndio', 'coreaudio', 'freebob'.

alsa_device.description: ALSA PCM device name to use. Defaults to the first hardware card.

alsa_nperiods.description: Number of periods of playback latency for ALSA backend.

alsa_period.description: Number of frames between JACK process() calls for ALSA backend. Must be a power of 2.

alsa_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz for ALSA backend.

alsa_inchannels.description: Number of capture channels for ALSA backend. 0 uses hardware maximum.

alsa_outchannels.description: Number of playback channels for ALSA backend. 0 uses hardware maximum.

alsa_dither.description: Dithering mode for ALSA backend: 'rectangular', 'triangular', 'shaped', or 'none'.

alsa_hwmeter.description: Enable hardware metering for ALSA devices that support it.

alsa_hwmon.description: Enable hardware monitoring of capture ports for zero-latency monitoring.

alsa_softmode.description: Ignore xruns reported by the ALSA driver.

alsa_midi_bridge.description: Provide bridging between ALSA MIDI and JACK MIDI for ALSA backend.

alsa_duplex.description: Enable duplex (both capture and playback) for ALSA backend.

alsa_capture_device.description: Specific device name for capture only in ALSA backend.

alsa_playback_device.description: Specific device name for playback only in ALSA backend.

dummy_capture.description: Number of capture ports for dummy backend.

dummy_playback.description: Number of playback ports for dummy backend.

dummy_period.description: Frames per period for dummy backend.

dummy_wait.description: Number of usecs to wait between engine processes for dummy backend.

pa_period.description: Frames per period for PortAudio backend.

pa_inchannels.description: Maximum number of input channels for PortAudio backend. 0 uses all available.

pa_outchannels.description: Maximum number of output channels for PortAudio backend. 0 uses all available.

net_audio_ins.description: Number of capture channels for Net backend.

net_audio_outs.description: Number of playback channels for Net backend.

net_midi_ins.description: Number of MIDI capture channels for Net backend.

net_midi_outs.description: Number of MIDI playback channels for Net backend.

net_period.description: Frames per period for Net backend.

net_num_periods.description: Network latency setting in number of periods for Net backend.

net_listen_port.description: Socket port for sync packets in Net backend.

net_factor.description: Factor for sample rate reduction in Net backend.

net_upstream_factor.description: Factor for sample rate reduction on the upstream in Net backend.
